# Employment Agreement Playbook

This is the source of truth. `rules/employment_agreement.yaml` is the machine-readable
version of this table; if the two disagree, this document wins and the YAML is wrong. 

| # | Clause | Required | Acceptable | Fallback / Review | Unacceptable | Escalate to |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PT-01 | Job Assignment and Salary | Yes | Legal Counsel, Human Resource Manager, Legal Engineer | Any other position | Missing | Human Resource Manager |
| HR-01 | Working hours | Yes | 40 hours | < 40 hours | > 40 hours | Human Resource Manager |
| TM-01 | Termination of the Contract | Yes | 1 month | > 1 month | < 1 month | Human Resource Manager |
